pages.title: The Satay Incident
pages.prompt:
Make one square 1:1 picture in the same pixel-art look as the attached restaurant image: cozy pixel art, soft outlines, warm afternoon light, a limited palette in these colours: cream #f3e4d0, warm brown #3f3533, orange #d9822b, gold #f2c14e, rust #8a4a2c, slate blue #5d7985, sage #6f8f5a. Full-bleed scene to every edge, with no border, frame, tape, paper edge or polaroid edge. It must read clearly at 320x320 pixels: one clear moment, few props, large simple shapes.

Who: two friends, waist up, at a small cafe table. Cyrus, matching the attached Cyrus character sheet exactly (wavy black hair, black rectangular glasses, light grey-blue collared shirt). Liam, matching the attached Liam character sheet exactly (dark grey knit beanie, blond hair, dark olive-brown shirt). Nobody else in focus; any other diners are small and blurred in the background.

What: a scrapbook memory called the satay incident. Front and centre on the table sits one plate of satay skewers with a small bowl of peanut sauce. Cyrus has just realised what is on the plate: eyes wide behind his glasses, both hands raised in a polite 'nope' and leaning back from it. Liam, startled, is sliding the plate away from Cyrus as fast as he can, mouth open in an 'oh no' face. It reads as a comic 'oops, never again' moment between friends, warm and funny, not scary: no one is ill, no medical items.

Where: a campus cafe patio in spring semester, leafy trees and a brick campus building softly blurred behind, gentle spring daylight.

No text anywhere: no words, letters, numbers, signs with writing, menus with writing or speech bubbles.
variations: Camera closer on Cyrus's face and raised hands, with the plate of satay large in the foreground and Liam partly in frame at the side.
The moment just before: the plate of satay has just been set down between them, Liam is reaching for a skewer with a hungry grin and Cyrus is starting to notice the peanut sauce, eyebrows rising.

The moment just after: the coin has landed, Maya hugs the jar to her chest with her eyes shut in a dramatic happy sigh, the paper-wrapped taco still on the table in front.

pages.title: The Plate of Fries
pages.prompt:
Make one square 1:1 picture in the same pixel-art look as the attached restaurant image: cozy pixel art, soft outlines, warm evening light, a limited palette in these colours: cream #f3e4d0, warm brown #3f3533, orange #d9822b, gold #f2c14e, rust #8a4a2c, slate blue #5d7985, sage #6f8f5a. Full-bleed scene to every edge, with no border, frame, tape, paper edge or polaroid edge. It must read clearly at 320x320 pixels: one clear moment, few props, large simple shapes.

Who: two friends, waist up, side by side in a burger joint booth. Mina, matching the attached Mina character sheet exactly (long wavy dark brown hair, orange ribbon bow tied in her hair, small earrings, rosy cheeks). Liam, matching the attached Liam character sheet exactly (dark grey knit beanie, blond hair, dark olive-brown shirt). Nobody else in focus; other diners are small and blurred in the background.

What: a scrapbook memory called the plate of fries. It is burger night. In the foreground, Liam holds a huge messy double-stack burger, two patties, but he has stopped mid-bite and is staring sideways at Mina's plate in disbelief. Mina is smiling quietly and contentedly, eating from a plain plate of golden fries, the only thing in front of her. The contrast between the giant double stack and the lonely plate of fries is the joke: funny and warm, never sad.

Where: a cosy campus burger joint in spring semester, warm lamps, wooden booth, a soft blurred counter behind.

No text anywhere: no words, letters, numbers, signs with writing, menus with writing or speech bubbles.
variations: Camera closer on the two plates side by side in the foreground, the towering double-stack burger next to the small plate of fries, with Liam's shocked face and Mina's calm smile above them.
The moment just after: Liam is holding out his double-stack burger toward Mina in a dramatic offer, and Mina, laughing softly, gently waves it off while holding up a single fry.
